claims: The ordered coach Freelance slot 4 is registered as a distinct candidate; this study does not prove automatic in-game activation.
External materials on Freelance settings and AI-vs-user activation do not identify physical PC22 Coach raw address or actual execution order.
conflicts: Fourth slot might be a shortcut, pregame preference, or engine AI input; no measured PC22 usage, probability or restore behavior.
The 4 coach Freelance slots, 4 Player PlayTypes, Playbook and Series are distinct concepts.
metrics: exact coach identity and ordered source UI slot
two game build-qualified Native getter readbacks without write
compare pregame, in-game ACE, timeout, observed active Freelance separately in future authorized testing
